title: Mock interview
text: Three mixed questions from days you have finished, a 30-minute timer, a score and a breakdown. Find it under Interview.

title: Level certificates
text: Finish a level and claim a certificate with a public page you can share, a PDF and an Add to LinkedIn link.

title: Public profiles
text: Opt in on your account page to get a profile with your streak, badges and calendar. Your email is never shown.

title: Invite a friend
text: Share your invite link. When your friend solves a first question, you both get a streak freeze.

title: Weekly leaderboard
text: Opt in to appear on a board that resets every Monday, so newcomers can win.

title: Share cards
text: Finish a day or hit a streak and get an image you can send to friends, with a link preview that looks good.

title: Every coding question tested
text: All Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced coding questions are now checked against hidden tests written from reference solutions.

title: Question feedback
text: Rate any question with a thumb and tell us if it felt too easy or too hard.

title: Faster pages and better accessibility
text: Smaller downloads, quicker pages on slow phones, and a keyboard and screen-reader pass across the site.

title: Streak freezes and repair
text: Earn a freeze every 7 practice days. A missed day will not wipe your streak, and you can repair a missed day once a month.

title: Review queue
text: Questions you struggled with come back after 1, 3, 7 and 21 days, so they stick.

title: Optional hints
text: Turn on hints in your account and get unstuck without spoiling the answer. Hints exist for Beginner Day 1 so far.

title: Reminder emails
text: Opt in to a gentle streak reminder and a weekly recap. One email a day at most, with a one-click unsubscribe.

title: Accounts you can recover
text: Email confirmation, password reset, a privacy page, data export and account deletion.

title: Plain-language compile errors
text: Common Java errors now come with a short explanation of what went wrong and how to fix it.

title: Made for phones
text: Problem, Code and Output tabs, a symbol row above the keyboard, an installable app and a friendly screen while the server wakes up.

title: Daily goal and celebrations
text: Pick a daily goal of 1, 3 or 5 questions and get a small celebration when you finish a day.
